title: Visualization & Query Intelligence Upgrade
description: A comprehensive update improving SurrealDB query generation, introducing client-side aggregation for complex metrics, and enhancing automatic chart visualization capabilities.

items.title: SurrealDB Optimization
items.description: Major upgrades to how the AI generates queries for SurrealDB.
details: **Real Sample Data**: The AI now inspects actual data values from your tables to generate precise queries with correct identifiers (e.g., specific supplier names).
**Syntax Guardrails**: Implemented strict rules preventing the use of unsupported functions (like `array::sum`) and enforcing valid SurrealQL patterns.
**Simplified Prompts**: Completely rewrote the AI instructions to focus on reliable, proven query patterns.

items.title: Client-Side Aggregation
items.description: Smart handling of complex aggregation queries.
details: **Hybrid Processing**: For operations not supported natively in single-step SurrealQL (like `SUM` by group), the system now intelligently fetches raw data and performs aggregation in the browser.
**Automatic Detection**: The dashboard automatically detects when data needs to be grouped and summed, handling it transparently for the user.

items.title: Enhanced Visualization Logic
items.description: Improved how data is turned into charts.
details: **Smart Heuristics**: Added new detection logic to identify aggregated data patterns (Category + Total) and automatically suggest the best chart type.
**Robust Config Generation**: Fixed issues where chart configurations wouldn't render, ensuring generated configs match the exact expected format.
**Aggressive Recommendations**: The AI is now more proactive in suggesting visualizations for suitable data, reducing 'null' responses.
